title: Random Story Generator
story: Writer's block strikes again. The blank page taunts you. What if a program could kickstart your creativity by randomly combining characters, places, and actions into silly story prompts?
why: Functions that select random elements from lists demonstrate how to build creative generators by composing independent data-picking functions.
analogy: A story generator is like a slot machine with three reels. Each reel (character, place, action) spins independently and lands on a random option. The fun comes from the unexpected combinations the machine produces.
expected_output:
Once upon a time...
Your random story is ready!
try_it: Add a fourth function `random_twist() -> Str` that picks a surprise twist ending, and include it in your story. Run the program several times to see different combinations.
tips: math.random_range(min, max) returns a random Int between min and max inclusive
Make sure your list length matches your random range: 4 items means range(0, 3)
Keep each function focused on ONE category — don't mix characters with places
Run your program multiple times to verify different outputs appear
common_mistakes: Using a random range that goes beyond the list length — causes an index error
Defining the list outside the function — each call should have its own fresh pick
